# `company.memorized_group_run_members`

Frozen membership and order of one group run; a later edit to the group cannot rewrite it.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with run_id + template_id | — | memorized_group_runs.id | Run whose membership this row froze. |
| `ordinal` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Position of this member in the order the run captured. |
| `template_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with run_id + template_id | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.template_id | Template that was a member when the run opened. |
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.id | Exact template revision the run captured. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this membership was frozen. |
